root_cause.text: In the Bluetooth HIDP session lifecycle, the `session->conn` `l2cap_conn` reference was not released or cleared in the `user->remove` (`hidp_session_remove`) callback, so the session thread later called `l2cap_unregister_user(session->conn, ...)` and final cleanup on a freed L2CAP connection, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly says the bug was "caused by not dropping l2cap_conn reference when user->remove callback is called," and the patch fixes this by adding `l2cap_conn_put(session->conn); session->conn = NULL;` in `hidp_session_remove()`, plus guarding later `l2cap_unregister_user(session->conn, &session->user)` and `l2cap_conn_put(session->conn)` with `if (session->conn)`.

The root cause is that `session->conn` is not released or cleared in the remove callback, yet the session thread later still uses it. That exact pattern is present here.
